# Deletion Criteria for Auto-Generated Skills

When a skill is a thin wrapper around a single tool call and duplicates functionality available through the base tool directly, delete it.

Before deleting, verify:
1. The skill body is a generic template with no domain-specific procedures
2. The skill duplicates functionality available through the base tool directly
3. The skill has NOT been substantially hand-edited beyond a template

If hand-edited substantially, it is no longer auto-generated — it is authored.
